note: Two EXAMPLES. Each one has a number, a metric, a target and a way to measure it.

nonFunctional.statement: The planner shall give a decision within 3000 ms for 95 percent of requests.
nonFunctional.metric: 95th percentile of the time from request to decision
nonFunctional.measure: A test sends 20 requests to a planner with fake outside services and takes the 95th percentile.

nonFunctional.statement: When an outside API is down, the planner shall still answer, and the decision shall be needs-review.
nonFunctional.metric: share of requests answered while the outside API is down
nonFunctional.measure: An integration test switches the fake holiday API off and checks for a needs-review answer.
